purpose: A result-blind, wall-clock adaptive training stop for the single-GPU 4-6 hour execution envelope. It preserves paired CE-versus-Online-v2 exposure and reserves time for the complete fixed held-out evaluation.

base_protocol.relationship: execution-only addendum; selection, seeds, attempts, token limits, arms, verifier, metrics, and the 40-row held-out set remain unchanged
base_protocol.conflict_rule: this addendum supersedes only base_protocol.stopping.arm, base_protocol.stopping.wall_clock, base_protocol.stopping.budget_exhaustion, and base_protocol.reporting.required_terminal_state

shared_clock.starts_at: the persisted timestamp immediately before the first shared_pre_update_baseline held-out generation request
shared_clock.clock_source: CLOCK_MONOTONIC for decisions plus UTC timestamps for receipts

paired_training.submission_unit: one CE wave and the Online-v2 wave with the same variant index form one indivisible paired wave
paired_training.single_gpu_arm_order: CE then Online-v2 for odd variant indices; Online-v2 then CE for even variant indices
paired_training.barrier: do not launch either arm of wave k+1 until both arms of wave k have committed terminal receipts and accepted checkpoints
paired_training.failure_rule: if one arm cannot complete a started wave, do not advance either arm; preserve diagnostics and mark the comparison INCOMPLETE
paired_training.selected_checkpoint: the latest checkpoint from the largest common completed wave count; never choose an earlier checkpoint using train or held-out results

heldout_evaluation.baseline_timing: complete and seal the shared pre-update baseline before training; expose only its elapsed time and cost counters to the stop controller, not outcomes
heldout_evaluation.final_timing: evaluate both locked latest-common-wave checkpoints after training stops
heldout_evaluation.completion_rule: all 40 rows must be attempted under the frozen four-attempt cap for every fixed checkpoint; aggregate outcomes cannot stop evaluation

adaptive_stop.decision_points: only after both arms have completed and committed the same wave
adaptive_stop.mandatory_prefix: complete paired waves v001 and v002 (40 training rows per arm) unless a hard failure or frozen resource cap makes the run INCOMPLETE
adaptive_stop.continue_rule_after_mandatory_prefix: launch the next paired wave only when remaining_seconds_to_shared_deadline >= evaluation_reserve_seconds + next_pair_prediction_seconds
adaptive_stop.stop_rule_after_mandatory_prefix: otherwise lock both latest-common-wave checkpoints and begin final held-out evaluation immediately
adaptive_stop.maximum_rule: after eight common waves (160 training rows per arm), stop training and begin final held-out evaluation
allowed_decision_inputs: frozen storage and numerical safety guards
adaptive_stop.already_started_work: finish, persist, and charge every request already started inside the current paired wave; never discard post-success or slower-arm work
adaptive_stop.resource_cap_rule: if either arm hits a frozen primary cap, stop at the last common completed wave; DONE remains possible only when at least two common waves completed and all fixed held-out evaluations complete

terminal_state.done: both arms completed the same 2-8 wave prefix, the selected checkpoints are the latest common wave, and every fixed checkpoint completed all 40 held-out rows before the shared hard deadline
terminal_state.incomplete: fewer than two common waves completed, the arms have unequal completed-wave prefixes, any required 40-row held-out evaluation is incomplete, or the shared hard deadline is reached before evidence finalization
terminal_state.winner_rule: report a CE-versus-Online-v2 comparison only for DONE; never infer a winner from unequal or incomplete partial arms
